description: Search USDA FoodData Central foods by keyword. Returns matching foods with FDC IDs and a preview of key nutrients (energy, protein, fat, carbs — not guaranteed complete). Use the returned fdcId with usda_get_food for the full nutrient profile, or usda_compare_foods for side-by-side comparisons. When dataType is omitted, defaults to SR Legacy (common whole foods with complete profiles) — or to Branded when brandOwner is set, since only Branded records carry one. Set dataType to ["Branded"] for packaged products, or include a UPC/GTIN code as the query. Pass brandOwner (e.g. "General Mills") to narrow branded results.

brandOwner.description: Filter branded results by brand owner name (e.g. "General Mills", "Kraft"). Only Branded records carry one, so setting this defaults dataType to ["Branded"] unless dataType is given explicitly.

dataType.description: FDC data sources to search. Omitting this defaults to ["SR Legacy"] (common whole foods, complete nutrient profiles), or to ["Branded"] when brandOwner is set. Include "Branded" for packaged products. Multiple values allowed.

foodCategory.description: Filter by USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products", "Vegetables and Vegetable Products"). Case-sensitive.

pageNumber.description: Page number (1-based). Use with totalPages to paginate.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default 10, maximum 50.

query.description: Search terms — food name, ingredient, or UPC/GTIN code for branded products. Examples: "chicken breast raw", "banana", "012345678901".

name: usda_search_foods

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_empty`: The query is empty or contains only whitespace. `no_results`: No foods matched the query in the specified data sources. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A food item matching the search query.

brandName.description: Brand name. Present for Branded items only.

brandOwner.description: Brand owner name. Present for Branded items only.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: USDA food description (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

fdcId.description: FDC ID — pass to usda_get_food, usda_get_foods, or usda_compare_foods.

foodCategory.description: USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products"). Absent for some branded items.

householdServingFullText.description: Serving description as it appears on the label (e.g. "1 cup", "1 oz"). Branded only.

nutrients.description: Preview nutrients per 100g — typically energy, protein, fat, carbs for SR Legacy. Not a complete profile; use usda_get_food for the full set.

items.description: A preview nutrient entry with ID, name, and amount per 100g.

publishedDate.description: Date the food entry was published in FDC.

servingSize.description: Serving size in grams from the product label. Branded only.

totalCount.description: Total foods matching the query across all pages.

totalHits.description: Total number of foods matching the query across all pages.

title: Search USDA Foods
